addr.description: HTTP(S) Vault server URL with a host, no query or fragment. The lifecycle parser additionally validates URL syntax. URL syntax and supported schemes are checked by the lifecycle parser after this structural schema.

token.description: Required token reference, supplied as any JSON value to validate; open separately requires non-empty resolved token bytes without forbidden HTTP control characters. This describes lifecycle parsing; the host validates secret-reference syntax and resolves material separately.

ca_cert_pem.description: Additional CA certificates, or null. When a string, the lifecycle parser requires at least one well-formed PEM CERTIFICATE with valid base64 and DER sequence length.

timeout_secs.description: HTTP timeout in seconds; the host call deadline still bounds a resolve. Fractional or exponent JSON number spellings are refused.
